title: Can Democrat Troy Jackson Oust Republican Senator Susan Collins in Maine?
author: John Harwood
content:
Graham Platner shook up the Maine Senate race - until he [dropped
out](https://zeteo.com/p/graham-platner-accused-sexual-assault). Now,
Democratic nominee **Troy Jackson** has seven weeks to end Republican Susan
Collins' three-decade run in a battle that could be crucial to Democrats
taking back the Senate.

According to polling, the race is
[tied](https://www.cnn.com/2026/09/09/politics/cnn-polls-maine-senate-
michigan-senate-abdul-el-sayed-susan-collins). Does Jackson have what it
takes? He joins **Zeteo 's John Harwood** for a candid conversation about his
campaign, live on Substack, where he took questions from **Zeteo** subscribers
watching in real time.

[Subscribe now](https://zeteo.com/subscribe)

Watch the **full video** **above** to find out why Jackson believes this is a
**" change election"** - and to hear him take on Collins over her [anti-
abortion](https://newrepublic.com/post/215422/susan-collins-anti-abortion-
judicial-nominee-ahead-election) track record, Medicare for All, and high gas
prices. Jackson also answers questions about Joe Manchin's
[endorsement](https://thehill.com/homenews/senate/6088483-manchin-susan-
collins-senate/) of Collins, his past as a Republican, and just how much he
aligns with Platner's politics.
